title: Tags with spaces: quote them or slugify them?
description: Issue #2 has two fixes that cannot both land. PR #3 keeps the tag text and changes the header format; PR #4 keeps the format and changes the tag text. Maintainers need to pick one direction before either is reviewed further.

members.notes: The report. Confirmed by a second user.
Quotes tags. Changes the header separator to commas with no migration, so existing multi-tag notes break.
Slugifies tags. Ten lines, no format change; the tag shown is no longer the text typed.
